light.notes: Lemon basil prefers warm, bright conditions and at least six hours of direct sun. A sunny window is conditional; weak northern winter light is not equivalent to full sun.

container.notes: Sources support container growing but this pack does not yet support a general pot-volume or depth figure.

water.notes: Use well-drained growing medium with moisture retention. Containers dry faster; this profile does not prescribe a fixed watering amount.

establishment.notes: Establish in warm, frost-safe conditions; universal months are intentionally not inferred.

unknowns: General minimum and preferred pot volume.
